messages:
Lee: Quick thread for action items from todays AH Q&A. I'll capture owners so nothing falls through cracks.

Ana: Top asks: Dedicated GA date, Private pilot status, cost-playbook / console guidance.

Jamie: Private pilot infra  on track for June; provisioning done for two pilots, third pending contract. NatSec still validating KMS and egress rules.

NatSec: KMS integration flagged one minor config gap; will post exact steps and mitigation by Friday EOD.

Raj: SLA question from Sales: can we offer 99.95% as default and 99.9% as premium?

Ana: Yes. Default GA = 99.95%. 99.9% = enterprise add-on with capacity commit.

Morgan: I'll produce SLA doc + template. Action: Morgan -> SLA draft by 2026-03-30, tag Legal & Sales.

Lee: Cost Playbook: EngInfra + Product to produce quick start guide + Console CTA for batching/quantization recommendations. Target 2026-04-10.

Ben: Sales asks for pricing guardrails for 99.9% tier. Raj/Ben to sync this week.

Raj: Scheduled sync Thu 10am PT. Ben, Legal can join?

Ben: Yep, set.

Sasha: Happy to review Console CTA UX. Add me please.

DeployBot: Perf-sweep job-128 completed; saw two p4-8 mem OOMs on long-seq. Logs: http://ci/internal/logs/job-128 (internal).

Lee: Action recap:
- Morgan: SLA doc + template (2026-03-30)
- Lee & EngInfra: Cost Playbook + Console CTA (2026-04-10)
- Jamie: Private pilot update (2026-04-24)
- NatSec: KMS + egress remediation steps (Fri EOD)
- Raj & Ben: Pricing sync (Thu 10am PT)

Ana: I'll update the release notes once perf-sweep is green.

Lee: Thanks all  if any volunteers for pilot testing or early Console UX, reply here and I'll add you. :rocket:
